text:
tom: Heads-up — Seastar Logistics flagged an invoice. They upgraded Dedicated capacity mid-month and were billed full month at new tier. Asking for proration.
rachel: paste invoice lines?
tom: ```
INV-2026-6340
2026-03-01 - 2026-03-31 Dedicated Standard (4 GPUs): $8,000
2026-03-18 Upgrade add-on: +$5,000
Credits applied: $0
```
oliver: contract shows upgrade effective 3/18 and standard proration applies. Need to compute days and adjust revenue.
emma: quick math: 14 days remaining (incl 3/18) out of 31 => prorated extra = 5000 * 14/31 = $2,258.06. So billed extra ~ $2,741.94 for earlier days.
tom: for month-end revrec, we should reclassify the portion for future service to deferred revenue and issue CN for the overbilled portion. Which account should we hit for the accrual until CN posts?
oliver: post JE for Feb close (actually March close) as: DR Sales Rev $2,258.06 / CR Deferred Rev $2,258.06. Create AP accrual for CN if not yet applied. Manager sign-off required for >$2k — @rachel ok?
rachel: approved. Please create billing ticket and CN.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-7888 and credit note CN-2026-621 for $2,258.06.
tom: finance ops, include calculation and contract clause link in the close memo and add a one-line note to monthly deck under "Revenue adjustments".
emma: done — will post JE and tag audit when complete. :white_check_mark:
